rules.title: Single Macro Context
rules.guidance: Keep one primary topic per page and remove contextual drift.

rules.title: Contextual Hierarchy
rules.guidance: Structure content from broad context to specific details with clear contextual flow.

rules.title: Topical Authority Formula
rules.guidance: Increase topical authority through historical consistency and topical coverage.

rules.title: Quality Nodes Priority
rules.guidance: Treat high-value pages as quality nodes and keep them well linked for crawler access.

rules.title: Cost of Retrieval
rules.guidance: Lower retrieval cost by improving direct answer clarity and structured information density.

rules.title: Question-Led Signals
rules.guidance: Use interrogative structures to match query intent and improve semantic signal clarity.

rules.title: Algorithmic Authorship Certainty
rules.guidance: Write with certainty, avoid hedging, and remove contextless wording.

rules.title: Numeric Specificity
rules.guidance: Use numeric qualifiers and explicit instance counts where they increase precision.

rules.title: Verb Context Alignment
rules.guidance: Choose verbs that align with the intended context and action expectation.

rules.title: Subordinate Text Optimization
rules.guidance: Make the first sentence after headings answer the heading directly without delay.

rules.title: No Delayed Answers
rules.guidance: Answer the question immediately; avoid definition detours on action-oriented pages.

rules.title: Anchor To Target Alignment
rules.guidance: Match anchor text with destination page topic/title intent.

rules.title: EAV Coverage
rules.guidance: Cover entity, attribute, and value comprehensively with concrete values.

rules.title: Hub-Spoke Context
rules.guidance: Use contextual hub-spoke linking between parent, sibling, and child topical nodes.
